name: Beat Lamp
description:
Audio-reactive lamps that pulse to the beat of jukebox music. Works with vanilla discs, resource pack music, and modded music discs.

Modes: Pulse - lamps scale and glow to the bass. RGB - rainbow color cycle. Spectrum - equalizer bars, columns of lamps fill up like one solid block. Ripple - rings expand outward from the group center. Wave - a wave runs along the group. Scan - a light sweeps back and forth.

Usage: Right-click a lamp to cycle modes, sneak + right-click to cycle colors, or use dye. Hold the Lamp Controller: click one corner, then click the opposite corner to link ALL lamps inside that area (max 512, range 48 blocks) with a live preview box - like Create's Super Glue. Right-click air to cancel a selection. Sneak + click a lamp with the controller to open settings (mode, sensitivity, speed, color, frameless, black background, particles, unlink group).
